title: Craft as a living practice
text: Shilpgram presents rural building traditions and crafts from western India, including Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra and Goa. Its structures and cultural spaces invite visitors to look beyond finished souvenirs. Materials, tools and ways of making help explain the relationship between craft and everyday life. Individual demonstrations and programmes vary, so check the current schedule.
